KRYCY.summary: Koryx Copper has completed its PFS drill program at the Haib Copper Project in Namibia, reporting assay results from 18 drill holes totaling 7,074 meters. The results show consistent wide intercepts with notably higher-grade zones near surface, particularly in Target Area 3 where mining is scheduled to begin. The company's technical team is focused on completing geological modeling and estimation work for an updated Mineral Resource Estimate (MRE) and Preliminary Feasibility Study (PFS), both expected to be published before the end of 2026.

RHDTY.title: Ruihe Data Technology Holdings Limited Begins Trading on OTCQX Best Market

MAR.title: Marovi’s Evaluation Intelligence Takes Executive Hiring to New Levels
MAR.summary: Marovi, an AI-powered executive search platform, announced market momentum by unveiling its proprietary Evaluation Intelligence engine that automates candidate evaluation against role-specific requirements. The platform combines 40 years of recruiting expertise with technology to replace traditional search firms and sourcing methods. Key customers including Marriott International, Finastra, and Total Safety reported significant improvements in hiring speed, cost efficiency, and talent evaluation quality.

The fund will invest at least 80% of assets in equity securities tied to major professional sports leagues and organizations, with up to 15% in private investments.

ELDN.title: Eledon Presents Updated Long-Term Phase 2 BESTOW Extension Study Results at the International Congress of The Transplantation Society
ELDN.summary: Eledon Pharmaceuticals announced updated Phase 2 BESTOW extension study results showing tegoprubart-treated kidney transplant patients maintained significantly higher kidney function (71 vs. 58 mL/min/1.73 m² eGFR at 24 months) compared to tacrolimus, with zero rejections beyond six months versus seven in the tacrolimus arm. The FDA granted Fast Track designation to tegoprubart for kidney transplant rejection prevention, and the company plans to initiate the Phase 3 LEGACY trial in Q4 2026.

He replaces Joseph Jasper, who resigned from the board. The company continues to focus on commercializing innovative medical devices and therapeutics for companion animals, with its lead product SPRYNG® currently available for commercial sale.

PRCT.title: PROCEPT DEADLINE: ROSEN, A RANKED AND LEADING LAW FIRM, Encourages PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important September 22 Deadline in Securities Class Action – PRCT
PRCT.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation for allegedly making materially false statements regarding handpiece unit sales and revenues. The lawsuit claims the company used undisclosed discount programs to artificially inflate sales figures, created excess inventory of over 10,000 units, and failed to disclose material risks. Investors who purchased stock between February 28, 2024 and February 25, 2026 may be eligible for compensation, with a September 22, 2026 deadline to serve as lead plaintiff.

PRCT.title: ROSEN, A LONGSTANDING FIRM, Encourages Doximity, Inc. Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action First Filed by the Firm – DOCS
PRCT.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed class action lawsuits against Doximity, Inc., PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation, and DNOW Inc. on behalf of investors who suffered losses. The Doximity lawsuit alleges the company overstated its Newsfeed's revenue impact and lost market share to competitors. PRCT.title: DNOW DEADLINE: ROSEN, A LONGSTANDING FIRM, Encourages DNOW Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action First Filed by the Firm – DNOW
PRCT.summary: Rosen Law Firm reminds investors in DNOW Inc., PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation, and Doximity Inc. of upcoming deadlines to join securities class action lawsuits. ALAR.title: ROSEN, TOP-RANKED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages AppLovin Corporation Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – APP

JOBY.title: JOBY Makes History With Fully Autonomous Flight Across the United States

ALAB.title: Tech Stocks Break Out: The Next Leg of the Bull Market
ALAB.summary: After four and a half months of consolidation, technology stocks are breaking out to the upside, led by semiconductor and AI-related companies. Despite concerns about AI safety and higher interest rates, the underlying economics of AI infrastructure investment remain strong, with demand for computing power continuing to expand beyond GPUs to CPUs, memory, and networking equipment. Bitcoin's rally signals returning risk appetite among investors.

ALAB.title: CRDO Down 20.3% in a Month: Is the Weakness an Opportunity?
ALAB.summary: Credo Technology (CRDO) has declined 20.3% over the past month despite posting 114.7% year-over-year revenue growth to $479 million in fiscal Q1 2027. VALU.title: Value Line's Q1 Earnings Down Y/Y on Lower Publishing Revenue

GFS.title: GlobalFoundries Drives Gross Margin Expansion: Can the Momentum Last?
GFS.summary: GlobalFoundries reported strong Q2 2026 results with gross profit rising 24% to $505M and IFRS gross margin expanding to 28.3%. DXST.title: Decent Holding Announces Planned Tiered Subscription Service Model for Suncare Platform

The company is shifting focus from network expansion to deepening service offerings through three subscription tiers (Essential Health Management at ~RMB 500/month, Enhanced Home Health Services at ~RMB 1,990/month, and Advanced Assisted Care at ~RMB 2,990/month). The rollout will be gradual through selected locations, with services provided by third-party healthcare providers rather than the company itself.

NTHI.title: NeOnc Charting New Nasal Route to Treating Brain Cancer
NTHI.summary: NeOnc Technologies (NASDAQ: NTHI) reported Phase 2a results for NEO100, an intranasal formulation of perillyl alcohol for recurrent high-grade glioma. The 24-patient study showed 48.9% six-month progression-free survival versus a 20% benchmark (p=0.0047), with median overall survival of 26.09 months. The novel nose-to-brain delivery approach aims to overcome blood-brain barrier challenges. While results are encouraging, the small sample size and open-label design warrant confirmation in larger randomized trials before regulatory approval.

YSS.title: YSS Loss Alert: Lose Money on Your York Space Systems Investment? BFA Law Reminds Investors of the Ongoing Securities Fraud Class Action to Recover Losses
YSS.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against York Space Systems Inc. (NYSE:YSS) for securities violations following a 10.9% stock drop on May 11, 2026. The company allegedly misrepresented the capabilities of its satellite software, with former employees claiming York Space Systems launched satellites without fully developed software and debugged them in orbit. Investors who purchased YSS stock during the class period have until October 30, 2026 to join the lawsuit.

YSS.title: YORK SPACE SYSTEMS DEADLINE: ROSEN, LEADING INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages York Space Systems Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – YSS
YSS.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against York Space Systems Inc. (YSS) alleging that the company made materially false and misleading statements regarding its satellite software functionality. The lawsuit claims York Space's onboard mission and payload software was not fully functional before launch, deceived the Pentagon's Space Development Agency (SDA) with false advertising, and delivered satellites with incomplete mission-critical software. Investors who purchased YSS securities during the class period (January 29, 2026 - May 11, 2026) or through the IPO registration statement may be eligible for compensation. The lead plaintiff deadline is October 30, 2026.

SCGLY.title: Ayvens 2029 strategic plan:  Aim for excellence. Execute better, every day.
SCGLY.summary: Ayvens announced its 2029 strategic plan with upgraded financial targets including ROTE of 14-16% (vs. 13-15% previously), CET1 ratio of ~12.5%, and cost-to-income ratio improvement to ~49%. The company expects leased fleet CO2 emissions to decrease from 101g/km in 2025 to 75-85g/km by 2029.

TLX.title: Telix and ITM Join Forces to Create a Radiopharmaceutical Powerhouse

The combined entity is expected to generate over $1.3 billion in pro forma 2026 revenue and achieve positive EBITDA by 2027.
